summary.text: Unlimited Qi Sea is Qi Xiang's rank eight signature killer move. It uses many qi path Immortal Gu as cores, absorbs worldly qi, and can attack and defend.

claims.text: Inside Qi Sea grotto-heaven, Qi Sea heavenly spirit sends a huge white qi pillar slamming down at Bai Ning Bing. Fang Yuan calls the attack Qi Xiang’s killer move Unlimited Qi Sea, grand and vast, complex and ever-changing, and the reason Qi Xiang was renowned.

Tens of thousands of supplementary Gu worms support it. After Qi Xiang created it he collected and stored qi in the immortal aperture so the move itself could grow. With Qi Xiang long dead and no rank eight in Qi clan, much of that stored qi had gradually dissipated; the heavenly spirit still barely activates the move again when Fang Yuan comes for the grotto-heaven. Fang Yuan’s time path clone uses the light of wisdom to deduce the move mid-fight, then kills the heavenly spirit when ownership requirements prove too strict, and the unmanned killer move stops at once.

After annexing the grotto-heaven he modifies Unlimited Qi Sea with the light of wisdom before the fate war. His version uses rank eight Immortal Gu Big Qi as the core, more than ten supplementary qi path Immortal Gu, hundreds of thousands of mortal Gu, and expendable qi path immortal materials. Offensively it spends immortal essence and immortal materials; defensively it absorbs external qi currents; power rises with the kinds of qi and qi path immortal materials stored in it. Qi Xiang left the move so the grotto-heaven’s heavenly spirit could pass myriad tribulations after his death. Fang Yuan calls the modified move his strongest offensive method at that moment, and he has already used it to break Primordial Origin’s primordial qi wall and absorb the wall’s qi path immortal materials, including a break inside Heavenly Court.
